title: Telemetry sender app
brief: Fleet telemetry product family: the FleetGo driver app that captures and sends samples, FleetGo for operations (which unit needs attention), and Fleet Platform for engineering (is the system healthy and why not).

artboards.title: Brand · node-mesh mark
artboards.tradeoff: The chosen symbol: hub plus a triangle of fleet nodes with one accent reporting node, shown at three sizes and as a lockup

artboards.title: App · Splash
artboards.tradeoff: Brand entry while the app decides first run vs. resume

artboards.title: App · Welcome
artboards.tradeoff: First run only: three value cards and the Set up my tracker CTA that leads into Add tracker

artboards.title: App · Add tracker (first-time setup)
artboards.tradeoff: Mandatory wizard: type or scan the device code, pick vehicle type and unit; no cancel because the app has no home until assigned

artboards.title: App · Move tracker (reassignment)
artboards.tradeoff: Same wizard reached from More once running: warns that the current link releases and keeps the device_id

artboards.title: App · Drive
artboards.tradeoff: Home: speed ring, buffer meter, today stats, shift action and the delivery timeline

artboards.title: App · Queue
artboards.tradeoff: Batch lifecycle, search by batch/device/seq and status chips that filter the list in place

artboards.title: App · Sync
artboards.tradeoff: Connection, device clock and endpoint state with one-tap fixes

artboards.title: App · More
artboards.tradeoff: Unit settings, working System/Light/Dark switch, move-tracker entry and diagnostics

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Live map
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet sidebar with status chips, dark map with clusters and alert pin, alert rail and the Fleet Assistant

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Device detail
artboards.tradeoff: The right rail becomes the unit fiche: live snapshot, signal health (age, gaps, last batch), sample tail and alert history

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Live map — Assistant tab
artboards.tradeoff: The Live map with the Assistant tab open: you talk to the agent in the rail and it answers with evidence, the tools it used and one-click actions, without leaving the map

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · agent-first live (proposal)
artboards.tradeoff: Proposal, kept beside v1: state rail on top (alerts always visible), agent as a permanent rail below with ⌘K, modes as chips over the map instead of screens; agent proposes actions, the human approves

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · alerts queue (proposal)
artboards.tradeoff: The Alerts destination the nav promises: a real queue with severity, age, owner and state, multi-select with bulk actions, saved views, and the agent triaging what needs a person versus what can be closed

artboards.title: Fleet Platform v2 · alerting & delivery (proposal)
artboards.tradeoff: The gap Platform had: delivery outcomes per channel (email, push, SMS, webhook), failures, suppressions, time-to-ack, per-rule evaluation health and a persistent agent that answers 'did this alert reach anyone'

artboards.title: Fleet Platform v2 · what is missing (proposal)
artboards.tradeoff: The audit: three things absent entirely (delivery log, per-rule evaluation, retention/export), four that should fold into fewer sections, and the three-surface shape with a persistent agent and a query bar

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · settings (proposal)
artboards.tradeoff: Proposal: rules written in plain language with the agent drafting changes as a diff you approve, the readable rule list kept for audit, watchlist and routing in the same place

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops v2 · modes, not screens (proposal)
artboards.tradeoff: Proposal: follow, replay and live as three states of one map with their exit keys, plus the keep/fold/drop ledger for the ten current boards and the rule for what the agent never absorbs

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Watchlist
artboards.tradeoff: Star is membership (per operator), drag order is the pin; the list doubles as map highlight, alert scope and follow group

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Follow mode
artboards.tradeoff: Camera lock on a device or the watched group, pan pauses follow with Resume, and follow stops after 5 min of stale data

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · 24 h replay
artboards.tradeoff: Timeline scrubber with playhead, speed presets and alert markers; positions rebuilt from stored samples

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Alert detail
artboards.tradeoff: Incident timeline, ownership, operator notes and the workflow actions for one alert

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Alert rules
artboards.tradeoff: Rule list and builder, zones, channels, quiet hours, escalation and snooze semantics

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Command palette
artboards.tradeoff: Cmd+K over the console with grouped device, action and navigation results plus the shortcuts sheet

artboards.title: FleetGo Ops · Connection & data states
artboards.tradeoff: State sheet for the Live map: disconnected banner and frozen map, per-device data age with thresholds, empty, error and skeleton loading

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Gateway & ingest
artboards.tradeoff: Responses by status, latency percentiles, devices with gateway errors and the live schema limits table

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Pipeline
artboards.tradeoff: Stage funnel with per-hop latency, blocked watermarks, dead-letter, partition lag strip and a pausable live tail

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Partitions
artboards.tradeoff: Per-partition lag, consumer assignment and the devices behind a hot partition; partition key is device_id, so order is guaranteed per device

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Workers
artboards.tradeoff: Per-worker health, worker log, assistant circuit breaker and tool-call mix

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Assistant
artboards.tradeoff: The agent on its own screen: recent conversations with the tools they called, tool latency and errors, and the degraded answers it admitted to

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Data health
artboards.tradeoff: Watermarks, rejected events and dedup in one screen: what blocks a device, what was refused, and how many replays were absorbed instead of stored

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Logs & traces
artboards.tradeoff: Searchable logs with inline trace ids and a span waterfall for one trace

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Payload inspector (request & response)
artboards.tradeoff: One exchange at a time: request body and headers with line numbers and inline annotations, response status/body, timing per stage and the verdict; annotated vs raw toggle, copy as cURL and replay

artboards.title: Fleet Platform · Schema & limits
artboards.tradeoff: The contract table with the exact error each violation returns, plus the runtime surface of the running build; generated, never a drifting document
